proposal.rationale: Evidence E-01 shows dispute volume rose to 1260 in Sep, E-03 indicates disputed bills are not predominantly estimated, E-04 shows no tariff change, supporting hypothesis H-BILLING-RULE-CHANGE that recent billing import validation rule changes cause systematic errors. Therefore we propose adjust_billing_rules to investigate and correct rule changes, and monitor_dispute_volume to track impact. (E-01, E-03, E-04). Assumptions: none. Unknowns: none. Side effect: Adjusting billing import validation rules may require reprocessing of affected bills, increasing short-term billing system load; monitoring dispute volume is read-only with negligible side effect. Reversibility: Rule adjustments can be rolled back to previous validated rule set if errors persist; monitoring is inherently reversible. Alternatives: Alternative actions such as increasing field staffing or deploying an AI ticket responder are outside the current release scope and would require separate approval.
